prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1487; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss by phone from the insured. Reports a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road. Insured states the other vehicle drifted into their lane. Scene photos requested through the app. Police report number not yet available.

Entry 2: Contacted the claimant by phone. Claimant confirms the sideswipe and reports neck pain and stiffness since the collision. Claimant is not represented by an attorney. Explained the claim process and the right to seek medical evaluation. Claimant plans to see a primary care provider this week.

Entry 3: Reviewed the photos submitted by the insured. Visible damage to the passenger-side rear quarter panel and mirror housing on the insured vehicle. Damage on the claimant vehicle appears to be on the driver-side front fender and door. Dashcam footage from the insured vehicle requested for review.

Entry 4: Obtained the police report. Officer noted both drivers reported a lane change at low speed. Other driver's statement differs from the insured's account on lane position at impact. Witness information listed but no witness has been reached yet. Liability remains under review.

Entry 5: Claimant provided medical documentation showing a diagnosis of cervical strain and a recommended course of physical therapy. Claimant asked for guidance on the injury portion of the claim. Advised claimant that a claims representative will follow up on the bodily injury evaluation once records are complete. File flagged for supervisor review due to injury component and unrepresented status.
